shots.title: Hero, studio

shots.prompt: Studio automotive photograph of a sleek four-door luxury sports saloon of original design with frameless doors, finished in midnight-blue metallic paint, three-quarter front view in a vast dark studio. One long overhead softbox draws a continuous highlight along the bonnet, shoulder line and roof; polished dark concrete floor with a soft reflection under the car; negative space on the left for a headline. Original vehicle design, unbadged. Overall look: glossy night editorial photography, neon reflections, 35mm; colour palette of midnight blue, chrome, magenta neon, warm gold. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
